ABOUT DRAFTMANGO

From an idea
to a working draft.

A workspace for building websites through conversation, with the source code and preview always close at hand.

Build, inspect and refine

Start with a description, an existing project or an example. In the builder, follow the conversation, inspect generated files, make a direct edit or ask for a focused change. Preview different screen sizes and keep related conversations together in a project.

The goal is to give you a useful draft you can understand and develop further. A generated design still needs your review: its copy, images, accessibility, security and any services it connects to.

Keep control of your work

Chats and projects are private to your account. The Code view lets you edit supported source files and refresh the browser preview. You can download project source as a ZIP or export an HTML preview, and import supported files from a public GitHub repository.

An export is a starting point for your own deployment. A visible form or checkout does not include a connected backend unless you have separately implemented it.

Where we are today

Draftmango is in its launch-preview stage. The public website is available, while account access and AI integrations are being prepared for wider use. Static-site publishing is enabled for restricted account testing. Paid subscriptions, custom-domain purchases and the terminal CLI are not yet open.

Our availability guide explains what each area does and what is still being prepared. Launch pricing shows the proposed plans without taking payment.
